question: 005 upper-tail difference is not removed by observed composition: do production magnitude, weather tails, interaction and repeated-profile weights give a consistent descriptive explanation?
production: Jan-Jun positive production quartiles fixed before comparisons; zero separate; common exact-hour/weekend contexts across all four positive bins within each period; report support
weather: Within month/hour/weekend/production-zero-positive cells compare lower25% and upper25% weather values; cells need >=8 records and distinct q25<q75; rain zero vs positive. Report mean and q95 peak contrasts, denominators and sign consistency, not significance
interaction: Weather contrasts reported separately for zero and positive production; no searching many variable combinations
profile_sensitivity: Recompute weighted within-context centering and weighted residual correlations on identical complete rows; no representative date deletion
lags: Unweighted within month/hour/weekend/production-state centered peak and production/weather; exact0/1/3/24/168-hour joins; associations only, not causality or confirmed advance availability
decision: Retain descriptive associations only when sign and scope stable; sparse or period-dependent results remain unresolved. Reuse existing basic EDA, no new raw correlation fishing.
